placements.why: All segments concern a database technology adoption decision — selecting Zypherion for the analytics pipeline with a committed migration timeline — which is an architecture-level organizational category nothing existing covers.
placements.title: technology infrastructure choices as organizational decisions
placements.frame: What infrastructure and technology decisions does the organization make, and how are they ratified?

placements.title: shift from current analytics stack to a purpose-built columnar platform
placements.frame: What does the organization commit to when it adopts a new analytics platform, and what performance evidence justifies the change?
placements.why: src-1 declares the adoption of Zypherion for analytics as a settled collective act; src-2 supplies the performance justification (15x faster columnar queries) as evidence for the adoption; src-3 commits the organization to a concrete migration timeline; src-4 ratifies all three as recorded decisions. Together they carry the theme of adopting a new analytics platform — a subject future envelopes will keep feeding as the migration progresses.
